column3: Thirteen (13) Mortgaged Properties (20.4%) are located in areas that are considered a high earthquake risk (seismic zones 3 or 4), and seismic reports were prepared with respect to each of these Mortgaged Properties (except for the CubeSmart Arlington Mortgaged Property), and based on those reports, no Mortgaged Property has a seismic expected loss greater than 28.0%.
